Now I can see the bugs clearly. Let me analyze them:

**Bug 1 — `publish()` stores the date in UTC instead of the author's local timezone (line 28):**
```python
post["date"] = now.astimezone(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()
```
A Berlin author posting at `2026-03-10T09:00:00 UTC` (which is 10:00 AM Berlin time) would get date `2026-03-10` in UTC — that happens to be OK here. But if they post at `2026-03-10T23:30:00 UTC` (which is `2026-03-11` in Berlin), the stored date would be `2026-03-10` instead of `2026-03-11`.
